init_locate3d_dataset: initialize a Locate3DDataset with annotations file path and optional ScanNet, ScanNet++, or ARKitScenes data directories
generate_scene_language_data: generate scene language data with object masks and bounding boxes from a dataset dictionary and scene data
add_positive_map_and_obj_ids: add positive token maps and object IDs to a dataset dictionary for language grounding
get_camera_views: retrieve camera views for a given scene dataset, scene name, and optional frames used
list_scenes: list all unique scenes from the annotations with their dataset source and frame ranges
